methods.name: Heuristic schedulers
methods.description: Five non-learning rules that pick the next request by a fixed priority.

methods.name: Plain Maskable PPO
methods.description: Maskable PPO over the shared feasibility mask, without bee-inspired observation features.

methods.name: Fixed-threshold BEE
methods.description: Maskable PPO whose observation adds bee-inspired features for each request (stimulus, a fixed threshold and the resulting activation). The action mask is the shared feasibility mask.

methods.name: Adaptive-threshold BEE (A6)
methods.description: Like fixed BEE, but the threshold in the observation features moves with scarcity, contention increase and unmet pressure, and adapts only when at least two pressure indicators fire. The action mask is the shared feasibility mask.

methods.name: Adaptive BEE first pass (A3)
methods.description: Earlier selected adaptive rule (contention-only threshold adaptation), superseded by A6 after the declared tie-break; shown for the A3 vs A6 comparison only. The action mask is the shared feasibility mask.
